common_voice_17_en.rationale: Validated read speech is a whole-clip negative for localized vocal events, event presence, shouting, and whispering. Rare incidental annotation noise remains possible.

crema_d_paired_v0.1.rationale: Acted lexical speech is a whole-clip vocal-event negative, but intensity is not treated as shouting supervision.

thorsten_voice_2021_06_emotional.rationale: Studio speech contains no annotated inline vocal events; its existing matched whisper and ordinary-style labels remain authoritative.

ravdess_v1_external_affect.rationale: The speech-only RAVDESS evaluation slice has affect labels but no inline vocal events; it is an external false-localization control and is never used for fitting.
